description: Calibrator fitted on the 200 gold dev examples using the deployed int8 ONNX model's own dev predictions (model.int8.onnx via OnnxPredictor, identical to finalize_probs.py; re-predicted, max |diff| 0.0 vs saved dev probs and vs the first 256 frozen test probs). Dev uids were dropped from training, no dev text in the train pool, so dev predictions are out-of-sample. dev_cv covers none/temperature/vector/isotonic (5-fold stratified CV); selection restricted to argmax-preserving methods (none, temperature) because vector flips 11/200 dev top labels (calibrated probs would contradict the frozen decisions) for a CV NLL gain of 0.004 (within fold-seed noise) and isotonic is far worse; lowest CV NLL among those = none.
